decisions.reason: Close to the firm's established dosimetry instruments and featured on the home page, reflecting strong related knowledge and clear commercial application.
Oncology risk management software builds on existing software integration and QA expertise, making it easy to assimilate and improve.
CT image quality phantom is closely related to existing medical imaging QA, so the firm can interpret results and apply its measurement knowledge.
Mammography phantom is distant from the firm's established dosimetry and QA base, limiting the firm's ability to assimilate early results and improve it.
Full field mammography phantom is also distant from existing knowledge, and without related R&D the firm is less able to learn from its early performance.
Medical imaging QA instruments are an extension of the firm's core measurement and QA capabilities, supporting absorptive capacity and learning.
